build.label: a designation set while drawing wins over the automatic one
a designation with no type is a turn point, and with no name is named for its place
a designation with an empty name falls back too
and an empty type is a turn point
fewer than two points is no route

designate.name: a shaping point becomes a point named for the route's default
with a type and a name
an empty name is kept as an empty name
an AMPS point changes type and keeps its name
with three AMPS points one can go back to shaping
the last two AMPS points are refused: the route comes back as it was
a shaping point being made shaping again is not refused
a new name keeps the point's type
the start can be made shaping, and is then a waypoint
a point nobody knows changes nothing

move.name: a drag onto a local point carries its charted elevation
a drag off it drops the charted elevation

insert.name: far from everything, it still goes in the nearest leg
near an existing point, the nearer leg wins
exactly on an existing point, the first of the legs that meet there wins
a leg with no length still counts
a route of one point has no leg to split

append.name: a named local point carries its elevation

plan.name: a patch merges over the plan
a route with no plan takes the defaults
an override merges with what the point already had
null clears the point's overrides, its clock too
a clock is set on a point
setting a clock moves it: the old anchor loses its clock and keeps its other overrides
an empty clock clears the anchor, and a point left with nothing is dropped
moving the anchor keeps the old anchor's other overrides
a clock on a point that has overrides keeps them

rename.name: snapped to a local point's place and elevation
